feedback.xSign: Check X — the target is {{direction}} of 0, so X is {{sign}}.

coordinateScale.gameDescription: Work out what one grid square is worth, then find the point.
coordinateScale.sameScale: Both axes use the same scale.

prompt.axisValue: Which point on the {{axis}} axis is at

feedback.scaleExplained: Look at the axis: from 0 to {{to}} there are {{squares}} squares, so one square is {{unit}}.
feedback.swapped: Move along X first, then along Y.
feedback.signError: Check the sign — which side of 0 should the value be on?

numberLinePlace.gameDescription: Count the ticks along the number line and click exactly where the number lives.

feedback.shouldBeLeft: The distance from 0 is right, but a negative number sits to the left of 0.
feedback.shouldBeRight: The distance from 0 is right, but a positive number sits to the right of 0.
feedback.countAgain: So close! Go back to the nearest tick that shows a number and count from there. Each tick is worth {{step}}.
feedback.oneTickWorth: Each tick on this line is worth {{step}}. Start from a tick that shows a number and count from there.

compareSigned.gameDescription: The further right on the line, the greater the number. Click the right one.
compareSigned.hint: Remember: further to the right means greater.

feedback.biggerDistanceIsSmaller: With negative numbers it flips: the further from 0, the smaller the number.
feedback.negativeIsAlwaysSmaller: Every negative number is smaller than every positive number, however big its digits look.
feedback.lookRight: Compare by position on the line, not by the digits: further right means greater.
feedback.recapGreatest: That is the number furthest to the right on the line — so it is the greatest.
feedback.recapSmallest: That is the number furthest to the left on the line — so it is the smallest.

absoluteValue.gameDescription: Absolute value is a distance. Measure it on the line and click the answer.

prompt.findFromDistance: Which negative number is {{distance}} away from 0?
prompt.findFromDistancePositive: Which positive number is {{distance}} away from 0?
prompt.distanceBetween: How far is it from point A to point B? Click the answer on the line.
prompt.trailing: ? Click the answer on the line.

feedback.neverNegative: A distance can never be negative — an absolute value is always 0 or more.
feedback.wrongSide: The distance is right, but you were asked about the other side of 0.
feedback.countTheGap: Count how many ticks lie between the two points — that is the distance between them.
feedback.measureFromZero: Measure from 0 to the number and count the ticks.

signedAddSub.gameDescription: Adding and subtracting is movement along the line. Find where you land.

prompt.land: Where do you land? Click the tick.

feedback.wrongDirection: Check the direction: the rest of this expression moves you {{direction}}.
feedback.addNegative: Adding a negative number moves you left.
feedback.subtractNegative: Subtracting a negative number turns you around and moves you right.
feedback.countSteps: Right direction! Count the number of steps again.

prompt.continuePattern: Continue the pattern — click the result on the line.

feedback.signError: The size is right — check the sign. Two matching signs give a positive result; different signs give a negative one.
feedback.magnitudeError: Work the numbers out without their signs first, then decide whether the result is positive or negative.
feedback.ladderHint: Look at the pattern above — it keeps going at the same rate.
